content: {"phoneNote":"Hero stacks two contact actions in the header and two more as text links right under the headline, so the call action is diluted before the reader even reaches the contact card that repeats it again.","desktopNote":"The layout is clean, but the 'Kje delam' band is a near-empty grey strip and the footer wordmark is blown up to twice the hero headline, unbalancing the lower half of the page.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Keep one strong 'Pokličite' as the hero primary button and drop the duplicate 'Pokličite me' / 'Pot do delavnice' text links (and the header pair on phone) so each screen has a single clear action.","Shrink the footer wordmark to a normal heading size and merge 'Kje delam' into the contact strip or the dark workshop band to remove the thin, empty grey section.","Give the services list a trade-specific feel: group emergency openings vs. workshop services, show prices on every row or none, and tighten the gap between hero and contact strip on desktop."],"blockers":[]}
